name: Gone ~Sugisarishi Hibi~
source:
Yuji Takeda is an unpopular actor who can not sell. During the shooting of a historical drama, he is struck by lightning and he find himself in a parallel world similar to the drama that was shot - Sengoku period full of ninja and samurai.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Our guy dreams of being an action star some day. While filming at a remote location, he got hit by lightning that sent him to a different world. There, he happen on a girl chase by some ninja. If he decide to fight and stay, he can help out some girls. Otherwise if he run back to the present, he will bring back a surprise or two.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
武田勇司是一名不得志的演员。在拍摄历史剧时，他被闪电击中，发现自己来到与正在拍摄的剧集相似的平行世界——满是忍者与武士的战国时代。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主人公梦想有朝一日成为动作明星。在偏远地点拍摄时，他被闪电击中，来到异世界。在那里，他偶遇一名被忍者追赶的少女。若选择战斗并留下，他便能帮助一些少女；否则，若逃回现代，也会带回一两个惊喜。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
